source_operation.description: Returns paginated and filtered audit logs.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: An optional, opaque pagination token.   Pass the `next_cursor` value returned in the previous POST /v1/logs response to retrieve the next page of log entries.   If absent, the first page of results is returned.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: An optional parameter that controls the chronological direction of the returned log entries.   Use `forward` to sort results from oldest to newest.   Use `backward` to sort results from newest to oldest.   If omitted, the default is `forward`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: An optional parameter that sets the maximum number of log entries to return per page.   Must be a positive integer no greater than 1000.  If omitted, the service’s default page size is applied.

200.description: Paginated audit logs have been returned.

400.description: Bad request. Fix the request and try again.

value.message: wrong direction, should be 'forward' or 'backward, but got: backwardd
wrong limit: limit should be less than 1000

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Try again later.

500.description: Server is not responding. Please try again later.

request.absence: nil optional fields omitted; explicit false/empty preserved

response.field_mapping: all declared response item properties, optional fields preserve absence; provider cannot inject SDK ref
response.scope_checks: provider project/pool/account fields, when declared; mismatches rejected
response.timestamps: RFC3339 fields parsed; DB naive time retained as raw string
response.numbers: integer decimal bytes retained without float64

errors.403: permission_denied; never a successful empty collection
errors.limit: incomplete with bounded typed prefix and cursor

retry: bounded safe read, including audit POST

pagination.limits: MaxItems/MaxPages; one CollectionTimeout shared across all calls
pagination.continuation: bound to scope, generation, endpoint ID, semantic filters and contract revision
pagination.single_response: replay original page plus skip when locally truncated

inventory: not included in initial Inventory branches
